reviews.text:
I loved this course, it is one of the best I have taken at Berkeley, and very relevant. Professor Perry is an expert, and able to answer decisively with depth to any questions that comes up, and it is genuinely fun to go to lecture because most of it is Q&A in the best way. He has an organized lecture, but most of the time as actually spent discussing what the class wants to discuss that comes up as a result of his plan or the materials.
